title: Field cylinder stock over ~1000 cells across builds on the column backend and is refused on the field backend (per-facet budget)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
### What happened

A cylinder stock wider than about 1000 cells builds on the column backend and is refused on the field backend. The field refusal is not the shared grid gate; it is the per-facet cell budget in `SdfField::from_mesh` (`field_gen.rs`, `MAX_CELLS_PER_FACET` = 1,048,576). `Stock::from_shape` meshes the cylinder with `stock_mesh` (32 segments), so each cap facet is a long thin triangle across the whole radius, and its bounding box spans millions of candidate cells.

Measured on main 3bb6647f6, cell 0.254 mm, height 1 mm:

| Diameter in cells | Column | Field |
|---|---|---|
| 4095 | builds | refused: facet 2 spans 3,306,212 candidate cells; the message asks for the mesh to be tessellated to the cell |
| 2000 | builds | refused: facet 6 spans 1,524,780 candidate cells |
| 1000 | builds | builds |
| 500 | builds | builds |

`backend.rs` says refusals are backend-independent, and names two field-only refusals (watertightness, a chord whose window spans the grid). This is a third, reached by valid stock the column arm accepts.

Found while reworking #4013 (review of the field cylinder gate).

Related (our reading of their titles, not checked against their plans): #589 and #26 retire the column engine; after that, a cylinder stock this wide would build on no backend.

### Steps to reproduce

1. `let shape = StockShape::Cylinder { diameter: 2000.0 * 0.254, height: 1.0 };`
2. `Stock::from_shape(Backend::Column, &shape, 0.254)` is `Ok`.
3. `Stock::from_shape(Backend::Field { band: 4 }, &shape, 0.254)` is `Err`, on facet 6's candidate-cell count (1,524,780), not on the grid gate.

Expected: both build, or both refuse by the same gate.

### Proposed fix

Tessellate the field cylinder's mesh to the cell before `from_mesh` (split each cap into triangles whose bounding boxes stay under the budget, as the error message itself asks), or build the cylinder's field from its exact distance instead of a mesh. A pin: a cylinder 2000 cells across builds on both backends.

### Version and OS

main 3bb6647f6 (source build), Windows 11.

### Labels

We cannot set labels. Our suggestion: `bug`, `area:sim`.
